'''Conjeni''' were sapients who resembled red-furred starfish from the [[Conjenus system/Legends|Conjenus system]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Vish sector/Legends|Vish sector]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Conjeni were starfish-shaped [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] covered with [[Color/Legends|reddish]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]]. They had two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] on the top-most [[Limb/Legends|arm]] of their bodies, and two large black eyes above a smooth-lipped [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. The middle two arms served as normal arms, and ended with three thin fingers and a tentacle-like thumb. The lower two arms acted as legs.<ref name="TSoK" />

==History==
The Conjeni hailed from the [[Conjenus system/Legends|Conjenus system]], located in the [[Vish sector/Legends|Vish sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Conjeni in the galaxy==
[[Durquist]] was a Conjeni [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and part of [[Bruce Mercy]]'s [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band. Along with [[Morph]], Durquist piloted the [[Starburst (freighter)|''Starburst'']] during pirate missions.<ref name="TSoK" />
